name: Design - Apple Developer
summary: Apple's design hub: Human Interface Guidelines, Figma and Sketch templates, SF Symbols, Icon Composer and design videos.
description: Apple's landing page for designing apps and games for its platforms: the Human Interface Guidelines, Apple Design Resources (Figma and Sketch templates, color guides), Icon Composer, the SF Symbols library of 7,000+ symbols, Pass Designer, Reality Composer Pro, design videos, developer stories, the Apple Design Awards and a Design Pathway for newcomers.
